cost_sentence: In this scenario a false negative costs more than a false positive, because a missed return stays as filed and nobody ever sees it, while a wasted examination shows in the no-change rate.
why_chosen: At 0.5 it picks out 34 of the 40 labelled change with 34 of 37 right, ahead of the tree's 31 of 40 and 31 of 43, and its scores can rank a list of any size, where the tree's top 25 returns all tie at 1.0.
why: A list of 25 picks out only 20 of the 40 returns labelled change and misses 20, where the list at 0.5 misses 6, so more capacity would pick out more.
